req.title: Task ids are monotonically increasing
req.statement: The system shall assign strictly increasing integer ids to newly created tasks.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that task IDs must be strictly increasing integers. This implies that each new task should have an ID greater than the previous one. To ensure this, we need to test the creation of tasks and verify that the IDs are assigned in a monotonically increasing order. We will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_monotonically_increasing_ids
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task using the POST /tasks/ endpoint.
expected: The new task ID is greater than the highest existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task
new_task = {"title": "New Task", "description": "Test task", "completed": false}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
new_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Verify the new task ID is greater than the highest existing task ID
assert new_task_id > 20

tests.name: test_create_task_with_existing_id
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Attempt to create a task with a specific ID that already exists.
expected: The system returns an HTTP 4xx error indicating a client error.

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_case
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Create a new task and verify the ID is exactly one more than the highest existing task ID.
expected: The new task ID is exactly 21, which is one more than the highest existing task ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Create a new task
new_task = {"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary test", "completed": false}
response = client.post("/tasks/", json=new_task)
assert response.status_code == 201
new_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Verify the new task ID is exactly 21
assert new_task_id == 21
